caption: Cass Freight year-over-year shipment growth (FRED FRGSHPUSM649NCIS, NSA; vermillion, left axis) against the SPY price (blue, right axis), 1993–2026. The two series broadly rise and fall together (the 2009 GFC trough and the 2022–24 freight recession are the key episodes) — the signature of a procyclical, coincident/lagging indicator, not a leading one. The source is not seasonally adjusted, so the year-over-year change is shown as the seasonally-robust growth signal. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: Hero shows YoY growth (seasonally-robust; never the raw NSA level) with the 0% line and the two freight episodes.
